text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Casino Control (Main Shareholder — Resorts World at Sentosa Pte. Ltd.) Notification 2010.

2. The Minister hereby designates Genting Singapore Limited (formerly known as Genting Singapore PLC), a company registered in Singapore, as the main shareholder of the casino operator, Resorts World at Sentosa Pte. Ltd. for the purposes of section 42 of the Act.
[S 368/2018 wef 01/06/2018]
